notes:
CTO: Lena Ortiz. Primary use-case: IDE copilot integrated into internal JetBrains/VSCode plugins + repo-aware code completion. Key asks: repository-scoped embeddings (per-repo namespace), chunking with function-level granularity, vector DB options that can be deployed inside VPC or on-prem (pgvector or Milvus), automatic embedding refresh on repo push webhooks.

Latency/throughput: dev experience must feel instant — streaming responses with token-level flush for IDE. Target p50 end-to-end completion latency <30ms for typical completions (short snippets), p95 for bigger contexts <150ms. Throughput: ~300 concurrent sessions during peak dev hours.

Model strategy: want model/version pinning per-team + deterministic fallback to smaller quantized models when high load. Also prefer reproducible generation for CI codegen jobs (seeded).

Security/residency: customer code cannot leave their VPC; preference for Private deployment or Dedicated with strict egress controls. Must support SSO (SAML) and KMS-integration for key wrapping. Audit log retention 1 year. Legal asked for data residency clause (EU customers later).

POC scope: 6 weeks — 1) infra + vector db in their lab, 2) prototype VSCode plugin with streaming completions, 3) eval harness for latency + quality vs GitHub Copilot. Success metrics: dev adoption (50 devs opt-in), avg completion helpfulness > 0.8 on internal rubric, cost per 1k tokens within target band.

Stated cost sensitivity: "We care about predictable unit economics — happy to pay for dedicated capacity if latency + residency guaranteed."  — Lena Ortiz.

Open items: legal redlines (INF-3427), confirm on-prem GPU budget, confirm vector DB encryption at rest SLA. See drive:/pricing/patchbay-pricing-deck-v2.pdf and drive:/security/patchbay-security-faq.docx.
